findings.reason: In thm-tgr-finite-current-production-balance, the Statement says zero production alone does not imply constant slice charge, but proof step 3.1 derives only ΔQ = −Φ; it gives no admissible case with nonzero Φ. The B-page counterexample supplies such a case but depends on this theorem, so it cannot justify this theorem’s claim. The revised tgr-mi01 summary also says zero flux is not necessary and production can outweigh positive outward flux without an example establishing that possibility. Add self-contained admissible current examples to establish these claims, or limit the statements to the exact balance criterion. This is round 1, so owner escalation is required.
